headline: Asian Currencies Mixed as Dollar Holds Firm Ahead of Fed Decision
summary: Asian currencies traded mixed while the US dollar held firm and the Japanese yen retreated ahead of the upcoming Federal Reserve policy decision.
why: Federal Reserve interest rate decisions dictate global liquidity conditions, influencing capital flows and exchange rate valuations across emerging and developed Asian markets.

impacts.name: USDJPY=X
impacts.why: Japanese yen retreated as the US dollar maintained strength ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting.

why_moved: Expectations surrounding US monetary policy shifts drive foreign exchange traders to reallocate capital into dollar-denominated assets.
